program.name: Swing and Sprint
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Swings and sprints: a swing EMOM and Tabatas, or a bell circuit and an AMRAP.
program.about: Kettlebell power with cardio in between. One day is an EMOM of swings, snatches and cleans, then Tabatas of sprints on the spot and fast moves; the other is a kettlebell circuit, then an AMRAP of bell and bodyweight moves. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Swing EMOM & sprint Tabatas / bell circuit & AMRAP
